Kadam A

kadamabhay95@gmail.com Phone no - 8237156455

CAREER PROFILE

7.9 years of total experience, with 5+ years as a Business Analyst collaborating with stakeholders to pinpoint business requirements and provide data-driven insights and solutions. Excellent in end-to-end SDLC processes. Proficient in report generation and dashboard creation. Acquired experience in Banking, BFSI, and Ed-Tech domains.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Business Analyst

ASCENDION SOLUTIONS (Oct 2024 - Present) Domain: BFSI Client: Citi Bank Tools: JIRA, Oracle SQL, Excel, Confluence

Report Analysis

Analyzing legacy reports to understand structure, metrics, and filter logic.

Documenting existing business rules, data sources, and transformation logic.

Mapping and Transformation

Mapping fields and filters from old to new reporting systems.

Ensuring functional equivalency between legacy and new reports.

Manual Testing

Validating report outputs by comparing old vs. new reports for accuracy.

Performing sanity checks and data integrity testing.

UAT and Production Support

Supporting end users during User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by capturing

feedback and issues and ensuring resolution.

Assisting in parallel run validations during production deployment.

Participating in go-live testing to ensure report readiness and performance.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Acting as a liaison between business teams and developers to clarify

requirements and resolve discrepancies.

Business Analyst

AIT Global India Pvt. Ltd. (April 2024 - July 2024) Domain: BFSI Tools: Agile, JIRA, Excel, Power BI, API

Collaborated with stakeholders to gather detailed requirements and translated

them into user stories.

Acted as a liaison between business stakeholders and the development team.

Worked with the Product Owner and development team to prioritise the product

backlog.

Participated in sprint planning sessions to clarify requirements and scope.

Coordinated and facilitated User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

Business Analyst

Pinnacleway-Biz Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (June 2023 - April 2024) Domain: BFSI Tools: Agile, JIRA, Excel, DAX, Power BI, MYSQL

Analysed existing business operations to identify key processes requiring

documentation.

Created detailed process maps and flowcharts using Lucidchart.

Created 30+ process documents detailing current and future states.

Business Analyst

UjjVilas Technologies and Softwares (April 2022 - June 2023) Domain: Banking & Edtech Tools: Agile, Power BI, DAX, MySQL, Advanced Excel, LOS, LMS

Gathered requirements for Loan Origination System (LOS).

Translated business requirements into technical specifications.

Created detailed user stories and use cases.

Generated reports to identify trends and loan performance metrics.

Analysed credit scores, debt-to-income ratios, and payment behaviour.

Business Analyst

O2 Breathing Brains Pvt Ltd (May 2021 - March 2022) Domain: Banking & Edtech Tools: Agile, Power BI, DAX, MySQL, Advanced Excel, LOS, LMS

Gathered LOS requirements from stakeholders.

Created user stories and use cases.

Collaborated with QA to develop test cases.

Combined data from different sources ensuring accurate data mapping.

Business Analyst

O2 Breathing Brains (Dec 2017 - May 2021) Domain: Banking & Edtech Tools: Agile, Power BI, DAX, MySQL, Advanced Excel, LOS, LMS

Gathered and translated LOS requirements.

Pulled data from various sources including CRM and external providers.

Combined and mapped data fields accurately.

Generated reports to evaluate loan performance metrics.

TOOLS

MySQL – 4 Years

Power BI – 2 Years



JIRA – 5 Years

Loan Origination System (LOS) – 3 Years

LucidChart – 3 Years

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Engineering (2013–2017)

Shivaji University, Kolhapur

Major in Mechanical Engineering
